instruction: Stand the blue pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
c = candidates[0]
grasp(c)

# Carry above the magenta pen holder
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen is held horizontally across the fingers (side vector).
# To orient it vertically upright, we can reorient the gripper so the pen's long axis points vertically (down/up).
# When approach=[0, 0, -1], the fingers point down, and side is horizontal, so the pen is horizontal.
# To make the pen vertical (along world Z), the gripper's side axis should be along [0, 0, 1] or [0, 0, -1].
# Side = approach x finger_axis.
# If approach is horizontal, e.g. [1, 0, 0], and finger_axis is horizontal, e.g. [0, 1, 0], then side = [0, 0, 1]!
# That pitches the held pen 90 degrees so it stands vertically.

# Move safely above the holder first
carry_to(hx, hy, height=0.25)

# Reorient gripper so side axis is vertical [0, 0, 1]
# approach = [1, 0, 0], finger_axis = [0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, 0, 1]
# Check reachability or adjust position
target_z = obs["table_z"] + rim_h + 0.08
move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

# Lower slightly into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.04)

# Release the pen
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("blue_pen", "magenta_holder")
